name: Harmonicord
detailed_description:
Accepting All Playtesters!

To playtest, request a Steam key in the Discord server, or download the game for free from Itch.io!


About the Game

The residents of Fortune's Hollow, once united around the magic that made the hamlet prosperous, are now plagued by infighting and misfortune. For the treasure hunter Finnegan, this is a chance to claim an unguarded bounty. But will his ambition survive his encounter with the desolate townsfolk and the noble minstrel intent on helping them?

Harmonicord is a non-linear 2D adventure full of puzzles, rope-swinging, and shenanigans. Explore the nooks and crannies of a quaint woodland while befriending forest creatures, playing songs, and solving conflicts.

Game Features

  • Discover shady glades, sunny fields, lofty treetops, and dim tunnels.

  • Work together with (and pick up and throw) the companions you gain to utilize unique abilities!

  • Sandbox-style puzzles encourage you to discover your own solutions.

  • Sail past deadly obstacles in fluid rope-swinging action!

  • Learn to play songs that take on a magic of their own.

  • Collect objects beyond your reach using your trusty lasso!

  • Bright pixel art brings a cheerful air to Fortune's Hollow.

  • Happy, upbeat, and relaxing soundtrack!

short_description: How wonderful and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony! But that is not the case here. Explore a divided forest and solve conflicts between its residents. Combine their unique abilities and learn their Harmonies as you unlock the wood's secrets on a rope-slinging adventure!
